The '''Whitescar Syndicate''' was the most powerful criminal mafia on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] in the wake of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The cartel unofficially controlled the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Jorra]], as well as across the [[Star system/Legends|star system]]. They required that nearly every citizen and business within the city pay protection fees or a tribute.
